item.text: The SDK timeline is ordered as events before, match, then events after. Search results render in reverse array order to show older results first. I’ll merge in that display order, skipping the shared boundary event and adding each result’s match index with the required offset.

The merge and a view test are in place. The test checks that a three-result chain renders as one tile, skips repeated boundary IDs, marks only direct matches for highlighting, and keeps each match linked to its own event. I’m running the existing search tests and type and style checks now.

item.text:
Room search now merges adjacent results whose context timelines share a boundary event. The merged tile shows that event once, highlights every direct match, and links each match to its own event ID. The change is in [RoomSearchView.tsx](/app/src/components/structures/RoomSearchView.tsx) and [SearchResultTile.tsx](/app/src/components/views/rooms/SearchResultTile.tsx).

Added coverage for multi-result chains, separate results, and a call event at the overlap boundary. All 10 relevant tests pass; TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` pass.
